name: Complete the retained Tier 2 Civic and request its official Government before the turn ends

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local p=b.CaptiveCapacityPlan(); local g=p.government; local t=g and g.target; local d=b.EnemyRetryDiagnosis(); assert(p.stage=='NEEDS_TIER2_CIVIC' and g.currentTier=='Tier1' and t and t.tier=='Tier2' and not t.civicOwned and (t.governmentType=='GOVERNMENT_MERCHANT_REPUBLIC' or t.governmentType=='GOVERNMENT_MONARCHY') and d.spyID==655368 and d.eventID==0 and d.eventTurn==23 and d.mission.turn==23 and d.outcome=='CAPTURED' and d.occupied==1 and d.capacity==1 and d.captive.captor==1 and d.captive.nameIndex==-1,'Tier 2 Civic candidate or original captive differs'); b.Queue('PREPARE_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC'); return t.civicType

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_PREPARE_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC' or a=='UNKNOWN_PREPARE_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC' or a=='REJECTED_PREPARE_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_PREPARE_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC' or a=='PENDING_PREPARE_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC'

local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local a=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_TIER2_CIVIC_ATTEMPT'); local r=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_TIER2_CIVIC_RECEIPT'); local g=b.ReadCapacityGovernment('Tier2'); return a and r and a.turn==Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() and r.token==a.token and r.phase=='SETTER_RETURNED' and r.status=='OBSERVED' and r.owned and r.afterTotal==a.beforeTotal+a.expectedTitleDelta and r.afterSpent==a.beforeSpent and g.stage=='READY_CHANGE' and g.civicCompletedThisTurn and g.target.governmentType==a.targetGovernment and g.target.unlocked

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; assert(b.ReadCapacityGovernment('Tier2').stage=='READY_CHANGE','official Tier 2 Government window closed'); b.Queue('CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT'); return 'official Tier 2 Government request queued in Civic completion turn'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' or a=='UNKNOWN_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' or a=='REJECTED_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' then error(a) end; return a=='REQUESTED_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT'

local i=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT_INTENTS'); local a=i and i.Tier2; local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return a and p and p:IsTurnActive() and Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()==a.turn+1

local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' or a=='UNKNOWN_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' or a=='REJECTED_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' or a=='PENDING_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_CHANGE_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT'

steps.code: ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.Queue('RESUME_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ'); return 'read-only Tier 2 Civic confirmation queued after the Government turn'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_RESUME_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ' or a=='UNKNOWN_RESUME_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ' or a=='REJECTED_RESUME_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ' or a=='PENDING_RESUME_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_RESUME_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local p=b.CaptiveCapacityPlan(); local g=p.government; local a=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_TIER2_CIVIC_ATTEMPT')); local c=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_TIER2_CIVIC_RECEIPT')); local cr=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_TIER2_CIVIC_READ')); local cm=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_TIER2_CIVIC')); local i=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT_INTENTS')).Tier2; local r=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_GOVERNMENT_READ')); local d=b.EnemyRetryDiagnosis(); assert(p.stage=='BUILD_SPIES' and p.buildingType=='BUILDING_GOV_SPIES' and g.currentTier=='Tier2' and a.turn==i.turn and c.token==a.token and c.status=='OBSERVED' and c.afterTotal==a.beforeTotal+a.expectedTitleDelta and c.afterSpent==a.beforeSpent and i.status=='PREPARED' and i.targetGovernment==a.targetGovernment and i.sourceCivicToken==a.token and i.sourceCivicType==a.civicType and i.sourceCivicDelta==a.expectedTitleDelta and i.beforeTotal==c.afterTotal and i.beforeSpent==c.afterSpent and r.status=='OBSERVED' and r.nativeSource=='UI_NATIVE_CULTURE' and r.governmentIndex==i.targetIndex and r.governmentType==g.currentType and r.governmentTier==g.currentTier and r.sourceCivicOwned and r.sourceCivicIndex==a.index and r.originalToken==i.token and r.originalTurn==i.turn and r.turn==i.turn+1 and r.total==i.beforeTotal and r.spent==i.beforeSpent and cr.action=='RESUME_TIER2_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ' and cr.status=='OBSERVED' and cr.owned and cr.index==a.index and cr.originalToken==a.token and cr.originalTurn==a.turn and cr.turn==r.turn and cr.total==r.total and cr.spent==r.spent and cm.originalToken==a.token and cm.readSerial==cr.serial and cm.afterTotal==cr.total and cm.afterSpent==cr.spent and d.spyID==655368 and d.eventID==0 and d.eventTurn==23 and d.mission.turn==23 and d.outcome=='CAPTURED' and d.occupied==1 and d.capacity==1 and d.captive.captor==1 and d.captive.nameIndex==-1,'native Tier 2 Civic, Government, title accounting or original captive differs'); return p.stage
